status: prospective design only; no generated artifacts or measurements
question: With the executable interface fixed, how does policy specificity affect generated Python agreement with a separately declared operational contract?

design.artifact: One new reusable Python artifact per arm, constructed without evaluation rows or labels; each used unchanged across the same existing development packets.
common: Explicit nested row.data interface and output schema
No example decisions, scorer, previous generated code or previous failure feedback
design.underspecified_instruction: Assess customer-analysis readiness, consistency of invoice cancellation with quantity, and acceptability of recorded unit price. Implement your interpretation; use unknown where the supplied information cannot support a decision. Return one decision per row and task.
design.explicit_instruction: Use the same broad instruction plus the exact frozen evaluation-contract.json operational policies.
design.treatment: Presence of the operational policy definitions. Additional policy text length is part of this combined information intervention; not an isolated formalism effect.
design.metadata_leakage_gate: Before execution, inspect both exact serialized construction prompts AND runtime packets. The underspecified arm must not receive policy conditions, required-field eligibility lists, rule messages, reference labels or explicit-policy text through metadata or runner packets. Common parsing metadata may expose types and parsing states, but not normative decisions. Save hashes and a field inventory; any filtering must be identical across arms except the declared construction policy treatment.

evaluation.cohorts: Preserve separate existing 24 development rows/72 decisions, 2 purposefully selected actual rows/6 decisions and 12 authored probes/36 decisions. No heldout access.
metrics: Execution time with identical measurement boundaries
evaluation.interpretation: A mismatch in the underspecified arm is disagreement with the evaluator's chosen policy, not proof of wrong business judgment or LLM reasoning failure. Multiple plausible policies are possible when requirements are omitted.
evaluation.unit: One artifact per arm is exploratory and correlated across rows; no inferential significance, representative prevalence or general accuracy claim.
evaluation.comparison: Compare these two new arms to each other. Earlier artifacts remain historical outcomes with different interfaces, not matched controls. Do not repair, replace or rerun earlier artifacts.

execution_gate.current_tick: Offline design review only, zero paid calls.
execution_gate.future: Fresh independent methods and implementation review of actual builder/prompts/packet filtering, frozen inputs and distinct condition IDs before any generation. New policy-specificity conditions must be recorded separately, never duplicate a consumed condition or disguise a retry.
execution_gate.budget: Must fit the existing 144-call/$5 nonrefunded campaign, all four predecessor ledgers and <=500 historical study calls per UTC day. Current consumed total80/$0.02410625 reported/$0.21650088 reserved. Re-audit actual totals and conservative token reservations before launch; never reset or refund.
execution_gate.failure: Preserve original artifacts and all errors; no repair, automatic retry, gold feedback or extension. If implementation cannot satisfy the leakage gate, do not execute.
